reviewNotes: All 11 sheets and all 35 list validations inspected; no defined names or external relationships. 496 cell formulas in 98 relative-reference formula families. 54 copy-down formula-column groups verified with no inconsistencies.
Nine unique threaded comments read (legacy comments duplicate their contents). Comments reinforce existing methodology; no hidden additional thresholds.
10_Validatie contains 15 route checklist controls and six external validation topics; checklist results are not consumed by final-status formulas.
04_Testontwerp definitions, strata and acceptance tables are not consumed by formulas; coverage and rubric reliability are manually asserted in 06_Analyse N/O.
07_Bewijs evidence register is not joined by formulas; evidence IDs are checked for presence but not resolved against registry.
01_Intake B44 autonomy-critical flag, B28 route-override rationale, and 08_Vergelijking P frontier status have no downstream formula check.

05_Testcases V row checks flag missing Test_Case_ID and duplicate candidate/case, but 06_Analyse does not read column V. Initial V formulas and input validations cover rows 6:25; analysis covers rows 6:2005.
All validations are list-only, with no numeric threshold/domain/count/cost bounds. N/A is offered for 06_Analyse N/O but PASS formulas require exact Ja.
07_Bewijs Q checks evidence grade M only for nonblank, so literal U would not by itself prevent COMPLETE if all other fields and numbers are present.
03_Poort1 M checks blank fields before FAIL; a blank domain can therefore display INCOMPLETE despite another explicit FAIL. Both block later eligibility, but exclusion reason is masked.

Previously directly recalculated source gaps: R1 broader scope can become DECISION-READY, missing environmental numbers can display numeric zero, partial cost aggregates can display despite insufficient evidence.
